Bounty Hunter.desc: Licensed or freelance retrieval specialist. You get paid when the target is in cuffs—or a slab.

benefits.title: Dead or alive paperwork
benefits.effect: You can always identify local bounty-posting customs and typical bond rules without a roll (who pays, who enforces, what voids a claim).

benefits.title: Pressure at range
benefits.effect: Once per scene per target, +1 to Intimidation against a target who knows you are armed and serious.

benefits.title: Hunter’s mark
benefits.effect: In the first round of combat, shoot at a target that has not yet acted; each raise adds 1d6 to damage.

benefits.title: Guild hall tone
benefits.effect: +1 to Persuasion when dealing with organizations that routinely work with hunters: bounty guilds, posting authorities, law-enforcement liaisons, or prison and transport contractors.

Politico.desc: Diplomat, public advocate, or deal-broker who wins conflicts before blasters clear leather.

benefits.title: Floor presence
benefits.effect: +1 to Persuasion when addressing a group, hearing, council, or negotiation table where your target can hear your full argument.

benefits.title: Biting retort
benefits.effect: Once per combat, as a free action, make a Taunt test against one target who can hear and understand you.

benefits.title: Protocol web
benefits.effect: After you spend a few hours talking to locals, you learn the local etiquette chain for formal talks (who must be approached first, titles to use, and what custom might offend) without a roll.

benefits.title: Market brief
benefits.effect: +1 to Persuasion when dealing with organizations built on policy and commerce: trade delegations, customs boards, colonial councils, or corporate affairs offices.

Hired Gun.desc: Mercenary, enforcer, or line soldier for credits. Violence is the job description.

benefits.title: Snap retaliation
benefits.effect: +1 to one of your Shooting rolls targeting an enemy that missed you last round.

benefits.title: Mercenary rep
benefits.effect: You recognize unit insignia, typical contract rates, and which officers actually pay on time—no roll for general knowledge of merc bands in the Outer Rim.

benefits.title: Heavy familiarity
benefits.effect: Ignore 1 point of multi-action penalty when your extra action is bracing, deploying, or drawing a heavy weapon.

benefits.title: Merc's code
benefits.effect: +1 to Persuasion when dealing with organizations that trade in force: mercenary companies, PMC contracting desks, arms suppliers, or veteran and muster societies.

Smuggler.desc: Blockade sprinter, fixer, or fast-talking loader. Cargo flies if the story holds.

benefits.title: Gray manifest
benefits.effect: +1 to Thievery or Stealth when hiding contraband in a vehicle, crate, or false panel you prepared at least one scene in advance.

benefits.title: Yeah, I bet you have...
benefits.effect: Once per scene, while in conversation with a target, roll Thievery; on a success, draw your blaster and gain the Drop on that target.

benefits.title: Fixer’s introduction
benefits.effect: In any starport Class III or larger, you may know a fence, loader’s union rep, or corrupt clerk by reputation; the GM names them when you arrive.

benefits.title: Gray channel
benefits.effect: +1 to Persuasion when dealing with organizations that routinely touch the shadow trade: fences, blockade-runner rings, dockside syndicates, or black-market clearing houses.

Technician.desc: Ship’s engineer, slicer, or grease-stained genius. If it has wires, you’ve sworn at it professionally.

benefits.title: Battlefield patch
benefits.effect: +1 to Repair on any item damaged within the last hour, during combat or an active chase.

benefits.title: Bad Motivator
benefits.effect: Spend a Benny and roll Repair at −2; on a success, a technical item within 4 meters of you spontaneously ceases to work until it is repaired. Droid Extras are Shaken instead.

benefits.title: Found a spare
benefits.effect: Once per scene, strip a working part from a nearby technical item. Roll Repair (−0 to −4, GM's call); on a success, the source item is undamaged but Unreliable until serviced. On a failure, it is damaged.

benefits.title: Yard cred
benefits.effect: +1 to Persuasion when dealing with organizations that keep ships and machines running: shipyards, mechanics’ unions, factory service desks, or certified repair and parts networks.

Scout.desc: Ranger, pathfinder, or wilderness operative. You move fast, stay hidden, and always know the terrain before anyone else does.

benefits.title: Covering withdrawal
benefits.effect: Once per combat, you may Run and Shoot in the same round with only -1 penalty instead of the normal -2.

benefits.title: Terrain reader
benefits.effect: When planetside, you always know local terrain features, likely ambush points, water sources, and safe camp sites — no roll needed.

benefits.title: Ghost step
benefits.effect: +1 to Stealth when stationary or moving at half Pace or less.

benefits.title: Frontier contacts
benefits.effect: +1 to Persuasion when dealing with organizations operating on the edge of civilization: Rebel cells in the field, planetary ranger corps, explorer guilds, or smuggler crews running wild space routes.

Medic.desc: Field surgeon, bacta specialist, or triage expert. You keep people alive when everything else is trying to kill them.

benefits.title: Trauma response
benefits.effect: Once per combat, you may make a Healing roll as a free action (instead of a full action) on an adjacent character who was wounded this round.

benefits.title: Field assessment
benefits.effect: You always know the nearest medical facility, what supplies are available locally, and whether injuries are treatable in the field — no roll needed.

benefits.title: Golden hour
benefits.effect: +1 to Healing when treating a wound within 1 hour of injury.

benefits.title: Medical network
benefits.effect: +1 to Persuasion when dealing with organizations built around care and supply: MedStar field units, bacta cartel reps, Alliance medical corps, refugee relief organizations, or Imperial garrison surgeons.

Scoundrel.desc: Gambler, grifter, or con artist. You live by your wits, your luck, and your ability to make people look the other way.

benefits.title: Dirty fighter
benefits.effect: Once per combat, when an enemy is Distracted or Vulnerable, you may make an attack against them as a free action. You do not fight fair — you fight smart.

benefits.title: Read the room
benefits.effect: You always know the local gambling scene, back-room deals, and who is running what hustle in any settlement — no Notice or Persuasion roll needed to find the seedy underbelly of a new location.

benefits.title: Silver tongue
benefits.effect: +1 to Persuasion when lying, bluffing, or running a con. Does not apply to honest social interactions.

benefits.title: Underworld ear
benefits.effect: +1 to Persuasion when dealing with organizations that live in the grey: sabacc dens, spice traders, debt collectors, crime family associates, or underworld fixers.
